dom.handler: return (env)=> { try { var q=document; return JSON.stringify({ radios: q.querySelectorAll('input[type=radio]').length, checks: q.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]').length, textareas: q.querySelectorAll('textarea').length, url: location.host, origin: location.origin, pageTitle: (document.title||'').slice(0,80) }); } catch(e){ return ''; } }
